search_window.basis: Begins at completed_at of preceding verified Food Line watch heartbeat; bounded retrospective search includes newly indexed news and official notices.

coverage_notes: Supplementary high-value recall only. Nationwide Food Line production collection is authoritative. No approval, publication, social post, schedule or automation state change.

Conducted 12 targeted web searches (four sole/last/full-service grocery loss, three weather/disaster-cancelled food distributions, three abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major service reductions, two official SNAP/WIC interruption). Queries centered October 27–28, 2026 with two-day recency filtering; local reports and direct official pages prioritized.

No independently verified new qualifying U.S. food-access interruption surfaced in this bounded interval. Search results skewed toward older incidents or unrelated resource/news items; no tool error or material coverage degradation occurred. Absence is not proof of no incident nationally.

Older September El Paso severe-storm distribution closure was outside this window and previously captured; excluded. https://kfoxtv.com/newsletter-daily/el-paso-food-bank-damage-forces-early-closures-after-severe-storms
